mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 63 degrees under overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a waning gibbous moon, and tonight will reach a low of 46 degrees with rain predicted.

Mayor Diaz has designated October as Community Planning Month to recognize the hard work of our planning department. Additionally, the city is reminding residents to keep an eye out for letters regarding mandatory cross connection control surveys to help protect our water quality.
Today you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness or trivia at Hop Haus, while tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On September 21, a retail theft of candy occurred at a shop in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue, where the individual was identified via surveillance and cited.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and you can grab a scoop since the store is currently open until 10:00 PM.
